summary: Batch initial schema installation to reduce durable sync waits before the daemon serves requests

replay.detail: No claim replay or projection rules change.

schema.detail: The same tables, indexes, triggers and schema version are installed; only transaction boundaries change.

rules.detail: Identity, signing, admission, startup readiness and request deadlines are unchanged. WAL and synchronous=FULL remain in use.

compatibility.detail: Core schema objects and the initial runtime DDL batches each commit together, reducing repeated durable syncs on first open. Independent migrations and backfills retain their boundaries.

downtime.detail: Cold startup performs fewer durable commits before binding listeners; no wait bound is increased and no retry is added.

recovery.detail: A failed schema chunk rolls back its new objects and preserves pre-existing data instead of retaining partial installation.
